text_sanskrit: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः  । नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः ॥ १-९ ॥
itrans: anye cha bahavaH shUrA madarthe tyaktajIvitAH . nAnAshastrapraharaNAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH .. 1-9 ..
translation: And many others (are) the warriors armed with diverse weapons and missiles, all dexterous in battle, that have renounced their life for my sake.
